raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "4052.86" %}
{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-fcopulae
  version: {{ version|replace("-", "_") }}

source:
  url:
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/fCopulae_{{ version }}.tar.gz
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/fCopulae/fCopulae_{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 08092dab6c53ae9d4000210fb784bf9d6ef2e8afc58afcde508f11f61448277d

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: generic
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ posix }}zip               # [win]
    - cross-r-base {{ r_base }}    # [build_platform != target_platform]
  host:
    - r-base
    - r-fbasics
    - r-fmultivar
    - r-timedate
    - r-timeseries
  run:
    - r-base
    - r-fbasics
    - r-fmultivar
    - r-timedate
    - r-timeseries

test:
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('fCopulae')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('fCopulae')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: https://www.rmetrics.org
  license: GPL-2.0-or-later
  summary: Provides a  collection of functions to manage, to investigate and to analyze bivariate financial returns by Copulae. Included are the families of Archemedean, Elliptical, Extreme Value, and Empirical Copulae.
  license_family: GPL2
  license_file:
    - {{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/GPL-2
    - {{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/GPL-3

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
    - janjagusch
